thread_text:
josh: FYI we had reports that the /guides/retries page still points to the old status URL and doesn't include the quick workaround we gave customers during the outage. Can someone do a tiny docs hotpatch? Prefer minimal changes so we can fast-merge.

lina: I can take this. Plan: branch docs/hotfix/retries-2026-03-20, add a small "Known issue" callout at top, replace the broken status link with the incident permalink, and add a tiny SDK + curl example showing a 3-attempt retry with backoff. Will open PR and request sam + anita for review.

pr-bot: PR opened: #4599 https://git.redwood-inference/pulls/4599 (docs/hotfix/retries-2026-03-20) — includes changes to content/retries.md and images/paths.

docs-ci: Preview for PR #4599: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/pr-4599 79: auto-link checks reported 1 broken image path in troubleshooting.

lina: Thanks docs-ci, fixing the image path now and adding the banner. Pushed commit af4b2a. Snippet I'm adding (keeps it intentionally minimal): ```bash
# quick curl retry (3 attempts, exponential backoff)
for i in 0 1 2; do
  curl -f -X POST "https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":32}' && break || sleep $((2**i))
done
```

sam: Quick read: please avoid wording that implies the SDK does automatic retries. Maybe phrase it: "Client-side workaround: retry with exponential backoff (up to 3 attempts)." Also keep banner short.

anita: Approving content-wise. Add the status permalink and a short note that we'll link the postmortem once available. For customers on release-v1.2 we should consider a backport if we see reports.

lina: Per anita, adding exact permalink. Using: https://status.redwood.inference/incidents/2026-03-19/kennel-02 — embedded in the banner. Banner draft: "Known issue (2026-03-19 23:0923:18 UTC): intermittent 503 responses. Workaround: retry with exponential backoff (up to 3 attempts). See https://status.redwood.inference/incidents/2026-03-19/kennel-02 for updates." Pushed commit c9d7e.

docs-ci: Preview updated: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/pr-4599/2 — all checks now passing (1 warning about alt text).

matt: This is docs-only and small. I'll approve a fast-track merge window at 15:00 UTC to avoid coinciding infra changes. No backport unless customers on release-v1.2 report impact.

sre-oncall: Confirm permalink matches incident record. Also: please do not advise disabling client-side timeouts; just recommend retries with backoff as shown.

lina: Merging in matt's window. Will watch for any customer requests and open backport PR to release-v1.2 if necessary. Thanks for the quick reviews :v:
